HOLIDAY DÉCOR · SEASONAL COMMERCE

Visit the brand website ↗

From festive inspiration to a clear shopping journey.

Seasonal commerce brings together product themes, customers’ preparation habits and a limited selling window. Candy & Nest offers a concrete perspective on this kind of business.

Commerce in the brand experience

  • Theme-led collections organize different decorating styles, from Gingerbread Village and Holiday Trees to Sweet Christmas and Pastel Christmas.
  • Product categories such as light-up décor, tabletop décor and ornaments help shoppers browse by use.
  • Seasonal imagery, product prices and purchase links connect decorating inspiration with shopping.

OUR SEASONAL COMMERCE APPROACH

Plan each step
around the selling season.

Our approach to seasonal commerce: plan products, content and selling rhythms together, with the scope tailored to each business stage.

  1. 01

    Before the season

    Review audiences, collection themes and price points, alongside the lead times needed for launch and fulfillment.

  2. 02

    Launch & anticipation

    Organize product pages and lifestyle content around collection themes to support early discovery.

  3. 03

    Peak-season selling

    Adapt merchandising, promotional timing and service information to product performance and stock availability.

  4. 04

    After the season

    Review collection performance, customer feedback and remaining inventory to inform the next season.
